title: cottendorfia paludosa
intro: Cottendorfia paludosa, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. It is a perennial herb that grows in wetland areas and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cottendorfia paludosa include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and calm digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
